summary: OMA filed a Form 6-K furnishing its October 2026 operational traffic report; no transaction is involved. Terminal passenger traffic across its 13 Mexican airports fell 4.8% year-over-year, with domestic down 6.5% and international up 5.9%; commercial traffic was 99.5% of the total and general aviation 0.5%. The filing is signed by CFO Ruffo Pérez Pliego and names investor-relations contacts, consistent with routine monthly disclosure under US domestic-equivalent Form 8-K practice. No board recommendation, advisor, price, or structural terms appear. Risk-arb angle: none; watch traffic trends as a demand read-through only.
